name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio:
Mateo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, not on the track but in his grandfather's autobody shop in Buenos Aires. He learned the art of paint application and color matching from a young age, developing a keen eye for detail. While initially focused on restoring classic cars, Mateo's passion shifted when he attended his first Turismo Carretera race. The vibrant liveries and meticulous finishes of the racing machines captivated him.

He honed his skills by working on local racing teams, mastering techniques in vinyl wrapping, custom paint jobs, and aerodynamic coatings. Mateo prides himself on his ability to blend aesthetic appeal with functional performance. He believes a well-executed paint job is not just about looking good, but also about optimizing airflow and reducing drag. His ambition led him to seek opportunities with international teams, eventually landing a coveted position with Garage 59. 

Mateo's approach is characterized by his visionary style. He is always experimenting with new materials and techniques, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in automotive paint and design. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and bring fresh ideas to the team, seeking innovative ways to improve performance and create visually striking designs.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Mateo is of average height, with a slender build and focused gaze.

quirks: Always wears a pair of lucky gloves when mixing paint.
Has a habit of sketching livery designs on napkins during lunch.
Insists on listening to tango music while working to maintain focus.
